Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding the naming of state buildings, facilities, or infrastructure.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to naming state buildings, facilities, andinfrastructure; and adding a new section to chapter 44.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 44.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature recognizes that, except for buildings on thecapitol campus, there is no policy or process for how state buildings,facilities, or infrastructure are named. It is the intent of thelegislature that policy be developed that would prohibit namingbuildings, facilities, or infrastructure after persons until ten yearsafter their death.
